A '''stormtrooper''' was stationed at [[Kejim Outpost]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. Upon discovering an opening in [[Sector 7]], he submitted an application for it and it was accepted. On his last shift prior to the transfer, this [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] was ordered to guard a landing pad occupied by a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] and several cargo containers with another stormtrooper. The stormtrooper informed the other about his transfer and the other reacted positively, commenting that it "should be a quiet last day for him." However, the statement would prove to be false, since unbeknownst to both stormtroopers, [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]] had [[Mission to Kejim|infiltrated]] the outpost. Both stormtroopers were killed by Katarn and Ors.
